# Anakin AI

> > Anakin AI provides AI automation tools, vector database API documentation, and guides for LLMs, embeddings, and AI application development.

The platform focuses on practical implementation guides for vector databases (particularly Milvus), LLM integration with tools like LlamaIndex and OpenAI, and AI ethics discussions. Content spans from technical API references to broader AI application topics.

## Key Topics

- Vector Databases
- Milvus
- RESTful HTTP APIs
- Python
- LlamaIndex
- OpenAI
- LLMs (Large Language Models)
- Vector Embeddings
- Gemini CLI
- API Usage
- Performance Optimization
- Batch Operations
- Database Operations
- AI Ethics
- Unstructured Data

## Vector Database API Reference

- [How to Use index API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-index-api-for-vector-databases): Index API guide for vector databases with REST/HTTP/JSON examples
- [How to Use query API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-query-api-for-vector-databases): Query API operations guide with REST/HTTP performance optimization tips
- [How to Use create API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-create-api-for-vector-databases): Create API guide for vector databases with RESTful HTTP/JSON examples
- [How to Use add_batch API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-add_batch-api-for-vector-databases): Milvus add_batch API guide for batch operations in vector databases
- [How to Use release_collection API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-release_collection-api-for-vector-databases): Milvus release_collection API guide with RESTful HTTP best practices
- [How to Use Get Progress API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-get-progress-api-for-vector-databases): Get Progress API for tracking vector database operations with RESTful JSON
- [How to Use FunctionType API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-functiontype-api-for-vector-databases): Milvus FunctionType API tutorial with RESTful HTTP/JSON examples
- [How to Use get_compaction_plans API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-get_compaction_plans-api-for-vector-databases): Milvus get_compaction_plans API tutorial with Python code examples
- [How to Use drop_role API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-drop_role-api-for-vector-databases): Milvus drop_role API guide for role management in vector databases
